title: 第8章 作弊的霍雨浩，王冬儿生气了
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

唐雅嘿嘿一笑：“没想到被你察觉出来了。他们两个确实是为了赚一笔钱，所以才跑到斗魂区来的。”

“雨浩，你这朋友倒是挺聪明的，要不要加入唐门啊？”

“王冬，你要加入吗？”霍雨浩期待地看着王冬儿。

王冬儿沉默地思考着，她前世确实加入了唐门，因为她以为是自己爸爸创立的宗门。但这一世，王冬儿只想离唐三有关的事情越远越好。

“我就不加入了。”

“啊，那真可惜呢。我们唐门可是传承了万年的宗门哦。唐三你知道吧，他就是我们唐门的创始人。”

“不用了，谢谢。”王冬儿再次礼貌拒绝。

“行吧，唐门随时欢迎你加入。”

唐雅很想复兴唐门，所以遇到合适的人就想要拉进来。不过唐门现在没落得太厉害了，所以并没有人愿意加入。贝贝和霍雨浩也是因为唐雅才会加入唐门。

他们正聊天时，斗魂台上，贝贝已经和徐三石打起来了。

贝贝的武魂是蓝电霸王龙，在兽武魂中算是最强的，万年前被称为最强强攻系兽武魂，到了现在依旧是。

徐三石的玄冥龟，也是顶级兽武魂，以防御著称，徐三石在外院也被称为“最强之盾”。

最强之矛和最强之盾到底谁能赢，让大家非常好奇。

贝贝的手臂上闪烁着蓝色的电光，快速冲到徐三石面前。

徐三石立刻将盾牌挡在身前，形成一个光罩将自己护在里面。

贝贝的龙爪拍在龟甲盾上，强大的力量让徐三石向后滑了一段距离。

“玄冥震！”

玄冥盾挡下贝贝的攻击后，徐三石立刻发动第一魂技。

与此同时，贝贝身后的两枚魂环同时亮起来，强大的雷电释放而出，将徐三石的光罩撕开。

就在徐三石准备反击之时，他忽然感觉脑袋被锤了一下，身体僵硬着不动。

贝贝立刻绕到徐三石背后，一脚踢在他的小腿上。

徐三石的身体轰然倒地。

王冬儿看向霍雨浩，发现他的眼睛里闪烁着紫色和金色的光。

“雨浩，刚刚是你？”

霍雨浩偷偷笑道：“没错，是我的魂技。”

王冬儿有些不太高兴：“我先走了。”

王冬儿起身，转身离开观众席。

霍雨浩有些疑惑，咋突然就走了？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Tang Ya chuckled: "I didn't expect you to notice it. The two of them really came to the Soul Fighting Zone to make some money."

"Yuhao, your friend is quite smart. Do you want to join the Tang Sect?"

"Wang Dong, do you want to join?" Huo Yuhao looked at Wang Dong'er expectantly.

Wang Donger thought silently. She did join the Tang Sect in her previous life because she thought it was the sect founded by her father.But in this life, Wang Dong'er just wanted to stay as far away from things related to Tang San as possible.

"I won't join."

"Ah, that's such a pity. Our Tang Sect is a sect that has been passed down for thousands of years. You know Tang San, he is the founder of our Tang Sect."

"No, thank you." Wang Donger politely refused again.

"Okay, Tang Clan welcomes you to join us at any time."

Tang Ya really wanted to revive the Tang Sect, so when she met the right person, she wanted to bring him in.However, the Tang Sect has declined too much now, so no one is willing to join.Beibei and Huo Yuhao also joined the Tang Clan because of Tang Ya.

While they were chatting, Beibei was already fighting with Xu Sanshi on the soul fighting stage.

Beibei's martial spirit is the Blue Electric Tyrannosaurus Rex, which is considered the strongest among the beast martial spirits. It was known as the strongest offensive beast martial spirit thousands of years ago, and it is still the same now.

Xu Sanshi's Xuanming Turtle is also a top-level beast martial spirit, famous for its defense. Xu Sanshi is also known as the "Strongest Shield" in the outer courtyard.

Everyone is very curious about who can win between the strongest spear and the strongest shield.

Beibei's arm flashed with blue electric light, and she quickly rushed to Xu Sanshi.

Xu Sanshi immediately put the shield in front of him, forming a light shield to protect himself inside.

Beibei's dragon claw hit the turtle shell shield, and the powerful force made Xu Sanshi slide back a certain distance.

"Xuan Ming Zhen!"

After Xuanming Shield blocked Beibei's attack, Xu Sanshi immediately activated his first soul skill.

At the same time, the two soul rings behind Beibei lit up at the same time, and powerful lightning was released, tearing Xu Sanshi's light shield apart.

Just when Xu Sanshi was about to fight back, he suddenly felt his head being hammered and his body was stiff and motionless.

Beibei immediately walked around behind Xu Sanshi and kicked him in the calf.

Xu Sanshi's body suddenly fell to the ground.

Wang Donger looked at Huo Yuhao and found that his eyes were shining with purple and gold light.

"Yuhao, was that you just now?"

Huo Yuhao secretly smiled and said, "Yes, it's my soul skill."

Wang Donger was a little unhappy: "I'm leaving first."

Wang Donger stood up, turned and left the audience.

Huo Yuhao was a little confused. Why did he leave so suddenly?
